name: Lindon
description: Realm of the High Elves on the western shore, ruled by High King Gil-galad.

name: Grey Havens (Mithlond)
description: The harbour of the Elves at the head of the Gulf of Lune, from which ships sail into the West. Home of Círdan the Shipwright.

name: Ost-in-Edhil (Eregion)
description: City of the Elven-smiths and capital of Eregion, where Celebrimbor has his forge.

name: Khazad-dûm
description: The great Dwarven kingdom under the Misty Mountains, at the height of its glory.

name: Tyrn Gorthad (Barrow-downs)
description: Ancient burial mounds on the southern road between Lindon and Eregion.

name: Imladris (Rivendell)
description: A hidden valley in the foothills north of Eregion.

name: Dúrnost
description: A ruined stronghold of the enemy in the frozen wastes of the Forodwaith.

name: Harfoot camp
description: Seasonal camp of the wandering Harfoots in the wilds of Rhovanion. Its position on this map is approximate.

name: The Grove
description: The orchard at the edge of the Greenwood where the Harfoots spend the autumn. Its position on this map is approximate.

name: Greenwood the Great
description: The vast forest east of the Anduin.

name: Tirharad
description: A village of Men in the Southlands, watched by the Elves since the fall of Morgoth.

name: Ostirith
description: The Elven watchtower above Tirharad.

name: Hordern
description: A neighbouring village of Tirharad.

name: Orodruin (Mount Doom)
description: The fire-mountain of the Southlands.

name: Númenórean camp
description: Field camp of the Númenórean expedition near the Anduin, outside the ash cloud. Its position on this map is approximate.

name: Pelargir
description: An old, half-abandoned Númenórean colony on the lower Anduin.

name: Armenelos
description: Capital and royal harbour of Númenor, the island kingdom of Men.

name: Hall of Lore
description: Archive founded by Elros, first king of Númenor. Its position on this map is approximate.

name: Andúnië
description: Western haven of Númenor and stronghold of the Faithful.

name: The Sundering Seas
description: The great ocean between Middle-earth and the Undying Lands.

name: The edge of the West
description: The sea-road to Valinor, the Undying Lands, which lie beyond the edge of this map.

name: The wastes of Rhûn
description: Deserts far to the east, where the stars are strange. Positions in Rhûn are approximate.

name: Stoor village
description: A canyon settlement of the Stoors, desert cousins of the Harfoots. Its position on this map is approximate.

name: Tom Bombadil's house
description: A cottage in the desert of Rhûn. Its position on this map is approximate.

name: Caras Gaer
description: Stronghold of the Dark Wizard in Rhûn. Its position on this map is approximate.
